name: Dirk van der Meer
bio:
Dirk's journey into motorsport catering was somewhat accidental. Initially training as a chef specializing in Michelin-star cuisine, he found himself working at a small cafe near the Zandvoort circuit during a race weekend. The energy of the paddock, the roar of the engines, and the demanding palates of the racing teams ignited a passion he never knew he had. He quickly realized that providing high-quality, nutritious meals under immense time pressure was a unique and exhilarating challenge.

He prides himself on sourcing local, sustainable ingredients whenever possible, even under the logistical constraints of a racing schedule. His meticulous planning and insistence on fresh preparation set him apart, ensuring that the Reiza Racing Academy team is always fueled for peak performance. He believes that a well-fed team is a winning team, and he strives to create a positive and energizing atmosphere in the catering area.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight side part.
physical.description: Dirk is a stocky man with a friendly face and a perpetual look of concentration.

quirks: Insists on brewing his own coffee with a pour-over method, even at the track.
Always has a small notebook and pen to jot down new recipe ideas or logistical improvements.
Unintentionally hums classical music when deeply focused on preparing food.
